title: Tiny GPT
description: A 64-token GPT-2-style decoder: learned token and position embeddings, four causal pre-norm transformer blocks with a tanh-approximated GELU feed-forward, a final layer norm, and an untied language-model head whose width is inferred from the output contract.
reference: Block structure follows Radford et al. 2019, "Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners" (GPT-2); the count was checked against the same architecture built in plain torch (256·128 + 64·128 + 4·(4·128 + 4·(128·128+128) + (512·128+512) + (128·512+128)) + 2·128 + 128·256 = 867,072), with the head untied rather than shared with the token embedding.
